metadata.description: Genos workspace connector and workflow skills for Claude.

plugins.name: genos
plugins.description: Genos workspace connector (MCP) with the workflow skills: work your Genos tasks, milestones and notes from Claude, with a clear record of every decision.

plugins.name: genos-engineering
plugins.description: Genos skills for software engineers: start a task, file a bug, open and ready a pull request, close out after a merge. Install it next to the genos plugin.

plugins.name: genos-product
plugins.description: Genos skills for product managers: status reports from data, specs, release notes, reprioritizing. Install it next to the genos plugin.

plugins.name: genos-designer
plugins.description: Genos skills for designers: answer feedback on a design note and turn it into tasks, hand a design to the builders, log UI problems as tasks. Install it next to the genos plugin.

plugins.name: genos-marketing
plugins.description: Genos skills for marketing: plan a campaign, see what publishes this week, build a launch checklist with approvals, write the campaign results. Install it next to the genos plugin.

plugins.name: genos-sales
plugins.description: Genos skills for sales: brief an account before a call, log a call with its follow-ups, review a pipeline kept as tasks. Install it next to the genos plugin.

plugins.name: genos-support
plugins.description: Genos skills for customer support: turn a customer report into a task without personal data, a weekly support digest, escalate a stuck issue to its owner. Install it next to the genos plugin.

plugins.name: genos-founder
plugins.description: Genos skills for founders and small teams: weekly priorities from the data, a draft investor update that is never sent, customer feedback turned into requests. Install it next to the genos plugin.

plugins.name: genos-research
plugins.description: Genos skills for researchers: log an experiment as a findings note, keep a literature review, plan a study, write the weekly research update. Install it next to the genos plugin.

plugins.name: genos-student
plugins.description: Genos skills for students: break an assignment into dated steps, lay out the study week, plan revision for an exam. Install it next to the genos plugin.

plugins.name: genos-teaching
plugins.description: Genos skills for teachers: plan a course by unit and lesson, prepare the teaching week, track grading without student names. Install it next to the genos plugin.
